description: Transport-independent Bluetooth Low Energy contracts for .NET. Provides adapter, device, GATT service and characteristic interfaces, reactive discovery and notification streams, Bluetooth address conversions, and a shared characteristic base for the Oakrey WinRT and BlueGigaBLE implementations.

Bluetooth Low Energy transport for BlueGiga serial adapters using BGLibExt. Windows Bluetooth Low Energy transport built on WinRT. Implements Oakrey.Bluetooth abstractions with service-filtered advertisement discovery, GATT service and characteristic lookup, characteristic writes, reactive notifications and indications, and dependency injection registration.

Core library for AarxMaps, a .NET SDK for Google Maps APIs. Provides shared HTTP infrastructure, dependency injection integration, and core abstractions used by feature modules like Places and Routes.

.NET SDK for the Google Maps Places API (New). Provides strongly-typed access to place search, details, autocomplete, and photos, with built-in dependency injection support for ASP.NET Core applications.
.NET SDK for the Google Maps Routes API. Provides strongly-typed access to Compute Routes and Route Matrix (Distance Matrix), with built-in dependency injection support for ASP.NET Core applications.

The admin area for Webority Chat in Webority.Ui.Razor markup: transcripts, ratings, unanswered questions, leads from chat, the profile editor and the script editor, under a Chat area the product secures with one policy.

The AI responder for Webority Chat: the agent loop over Webority.Ai with the stream-aware reply guard and figure check, presentation tools, topic and injection guardrails, knowledge citations as Sources parts and suggested replies as QuickReplies parts.

The Webority Chat routes for one surface: profile, conversations, messages streamed as Server-Sent Events, input requests, actions, ratings and attachments, with the feature filter, the captcha gate, named rate-limit policies and RFC 9457 problems with fixed codes.
The app-chat tag helper for Razor sites, with the chat-elements styles and global bundle as static web assets.
The Azure Communication Services SMS adapter for Webority Chat: sends phone one-time codes over managed identity.
The Azure Speech adapter for Webority Chat: short-lived tokens over managed identity for dictation and read-aloud.
